title: Populated state proof
description: Evidence artefact produced by validation/validate_populated_state.py and consumed by the OpenCare platform promoter before granting first-class status. The package must produce this file; the platform must verify it.

package_version.description: Must match package.yaml#metadata.version exactly. Validator fails if mismatch.

package_content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical package artefact. Used to detect tampering between proof generation and promotion.

endpoint_evidence.description: One entry per backend route declared in contracts/routes.yaml with populated_assertion_required: true

shape_hash.description: SHA-256 of the response JSON schema. Used to detect contract drift.

row_count.description: Rows returned from the response. Zero may be valid for routes marked empty_response_valid: true.

row_count_meets_minimum.description: True if row_count >= the route's minimum_rows_for_populated assertion. False blocks promotion unless empty_response_valid is true.

policy_decisions.description: Governance policy enforcement decisions logged during the call.

phi_masking_evidence.description: Evidence that PHI/citizen identifiers are correctly masked under non-admin roles.

ndmo_classification_alignment.description: Statement that the data classification map (Restricted / Confidential / Internal / Public) is aligned with NDMO classification rules.

bilingual_coverage_evidence.description: Validation that every i18n key in en.yaml has a corresponding entry in ar.yaml and vice versa.

native_speaker_review_complete.description: Must be true before customer-facing rendering. False during initial pilot is acceptable; this flag must be set true after native review.

overall_status.description: Pass requires all required components to be pass. Warn allows soft conditions (e.g., bilingual native review pending). Fail blocks promotion.
